Axel Brandes is a professor, senior physician (overlæge) and doctor of medicine (dr.med.) based at [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]], part of [[syddansk-universitetshospital|Syddansk Universitetshospital]] [^src1] [^src2]. He is a longstanding member of the steering committee for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK), the Danish national clinical quality database for atrial fibrillation care [^src1] [^src3].

Brandes' role has been documented across successive AFDK annual reports. In the 2023 annual report, covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, he appears among the steering group members listed in the chapter on the database's data foundation, patient-population definitions, and data-collection limitations [^src1]. That report situates his work within a broader account of atrial fibrillation incidence across Denmark's five regions and the demographic makeup of registered patients [^src1].

In the 2024 annual report, covering 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024 — the first year in which data from practising cardiologists were included in the database (reported since 1 June 2023) — Brandes is named as one of the "forpersoner for databasen" (chairs/leaders of the database), formally identifying him as a database leader of AFDK [^src2]. That report covers 22,073 incident and 136,420 prevalent atrial fibrillation patients and evaluates treatment quality through eight main indicators [^src2]. Later in the same 2024 report, in the section covering pages 66–70 — which discusses patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes Hospitalsenhed Midt's patient-education program running since 2012, and lists the steering group's members and methodological limitations — Brandes is described as serving "som formand for styregruppens formandskab," i.e., as chair of the steering committee's chairmanship, tying him directly to [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP), the national program under which AFDK operates [^src3]. This section also underscores AFDK's status as a nationwide quality database operating under the Danish Society of Cardiology and approved by the Danish Health Authority [^src3].

Taken together, the record shows Axel Brandes as a senior clinical figure whose institutional base (Esbjerg og Grindsted sygehus, Syddansk Universitetshospital) and leadership role on the AFDK steering committee span at least two consecutive annual reporting cycles of the database, from the 2022–2023 period through the 2023–2024 period [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].
